sources.title: Lyra: An Efficient and Speech-Centric Framework - GitHub
sources.snippet: Lyra shows superiority compared with leading omni-models in: Stronger performance: Achieve SOTA results across a variety of speech-centric tasks. More versatile: Support image, video, speech/long-speech, sound understanding and speech generation. More efficient: Less training data, support faster training and inference.
